newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy set to keep majority ENI share in 97.
newsitem.headline: Italy set to keep majority ENI share in 97.

text.p: Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Tuesday Italy would "probably" maintain a majority stake in energy group ENI after a third tranche sale planned for later this year.

"We still have not thought of how big the third tranche will be, but we probably won't fall beneath the 51 percent level, even if nothing prevents us from doing so," Ciampi told the public works commission of the upper house (Senate).

"Right now we have 68 percent. The last (tanche) sale was for 15 percent, so we have margins to do (this) again," Ciampi said. An initial 15 percent stake in ENI was placed on the market in November 1995.
